name: Pageform
summary: AI-native virtual data room: turns deal documents into a narrative room with an AI agent, viewer analytics and e-signatures.
description: AI-native data room for fundraising, diligence and deals: upload documents and an AI agent builds a structured, narrative room you can edit, audit and analyze through chat. Page- and section-level viewer analytics show what each reader opens and revisits, alongside Q&A, NDA gating, granular permissions, e-signatures and subscriber updates. Built for founders, fund managers and investment teams; free plan with Docs, Core and Pro paid tiers.

narrative data room with custom sections and blocks
NDA gating, password/email gating, custom domains, watermarking
